# Changelog

All notable changes to this plugin will be documented here.

## 1.0.0 — initial release

- Added the `commsync` MCP server pointing at CommSync's hosted Streamable HTTP endpoint (`https://server.commsync.ai/api/mcp`).
- Auth uses OAuth with CommSync user login and dynamic client registration — no API key or client ID to configure. The user picks which phone and email lines Cursor can use on the consent screen.
- Logo: CommSync's official app mark.
